title: Pulling from remote doesn't update Auto Increment global state
relevance: The maintainer-authored reproducer uses DOLT_PULL followed by an auto-increment insert and reports a duplicate key because the global auto_increment state is not updated after pull.
relationshipToChronicleDbEvidence: Independent upstream confirmation of the same continuation-authority mechanism observed by the expanded Dolt campaign; it is not presented as a fix or as proof that every version has the same failure rate.
query: repo:dolthub/dolt DOLT_CLONE AUTO_INCREMENT context canceled / pull auto increment
